# Version 4.152.2
> **Ganesh upload failure handling** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.202/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed GPU work does not proceed with stale buffers** — Propagates render-task, flush, and submission failures and rejects incomplete uploads under memory pressure. Affected draws are dropped; the existing managed flush operations remain void. ([#5069](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5069), [#5117](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5117))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007** — Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. ([#5121](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5121))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.202

The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 by scoping vendored-source warning suppression. The bundled HarfBuzz engine and exported ABI are unchanged.
